verificationLimits: Downloaded archive SHA256 values match GitHub artifact metadata before extraction; member paths and symlink entries were checked before extraction.

Source, harness, package and protected-file hashes present in reports were compared with their exact Git revisions. Older reports without an embedded source SHA are identified through their verified artifact/run envelope.

Every per-capture SHA256 recorded by the reviewed reports was compared. Other capture files were checked for presence and hashed under a verified archive; their reports do not supply a separate comparison digest.

Recorded browser versions include Chromium 155.0.8059.39 and 155.0.8059.84. Runner images differ between jobs and are listed individually. Exact browser versions are not invented for older reports that omit them.
Targeted text enlargement, emulated touch and 720 CSS pixel zoom reflow equivalents are not native browser zoom, physical-device testing or accessibility certification.
Pages success confirms deployment of the protected export; it does not publish frontend/dist or grant founder visual acceptance.
No workflow was retried, no threshold/assertion was relaxed, and no repository runtime, harness or documentation file was edited during this monitoring task.
